name: Midas Golden Touch 2
review:
Midas Golden Touch 2 is a 3x5, 15-line sequel with multiplier wilds, the Gift of Midas feature and a bonus game with sticky respins.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 15,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.27%.

The Gift of Midas feature adds a golden twist to base spins, and the bonus's sticky respins hold winning symbols while the rest respins. This sequel raised the cap to 15,000x.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
